name: SNAP-8

lead: SNAP-8 (acetyl octapeptide-3) is a longer analogue of Argireline marketed for reducing expression wrinkles. It appears in anti-aging serums and eye creams.
Publicly available evidence is thin and mostly from manufacturers; independent controlled trials are scarce.

paras: Like Argireline, it is designed to imitate part of SNAP-25 and interfere with SNARE complex assembly to lower neurotransmitter release at the muscle junction, though skin delivery limits real effect.
It is considered low risk and is unrestricted as a cosmetic ingredient. Expect modest, reversible effects at best.
